name: Micspam
author: nnfz
description: Duplicates the player output into a virtual audio cable so Discord and games see the music as a microphone. Keeps the connection alive on its own.

settings.label: Device name
settings.description: Substring of the cable output name. VB-CABLE: 'CABLE Input'. VoiceMeeter: 'VoiceMeeter Input'.

settings.label: Voice volume (%)
settings.description: Cable only. Does not change what you hear in your headphones.

settings.label: Check interval (ms)
settings.description: How often to make sure the cable is still attached
